fields.why: Table 1 gives chi-square p-values for influenza positivity and vaccination across 5 age groups and 4 race/ethnicity groups (rule 2), and the text says age-specific VE 'varied by age group'.
Age and race/ethnicity are the SPDs with 3+ groups compared; sex is two groups, and study site and self-rated health are not SPDs.

The Table 1 chi-squares are omnibus tests across age and race; the age-specific VE estimates are each judged against VE = 0, not against one another, so 'varied by age group' is side by side. The mechanical flag points to the Table 1 chi-square, which does not cover the VE-by-age entry.
